svg.title: Entropy accounting for heat flowing from hot to cold
svg.desc: Four thousand joules flow from a reservoir at 600 kelvin to one at 250 kelvin. Reservoir temperatures remain fixed. The hot reservoir loses 6.67 joules per kelvin, the cold gains 16, and total entropy increases by 9.33 joules per kelvin. Signed bars share the same scale. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Entropy rises when heat flows between unequal temperatures
Equal heat leaves the hot reservoir and enters the cold one. The cold reservoir gains more entropy
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
